subject: Contract sprint: finalize vendor onboarding checklist & redlines
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Kari O'Neil <kari.oneil@greenridge.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Contract sprint: finalize vendor onboarding checklist & redlines

Kari —

Following up from our call last week. Greenridge flagged a few remaining MSA redlines and procurement items; to avoid a long back-and-forth, we'd like to run a short "contract sprint" with your legal + procurement folks to go line-by-line and close items we can while capturing anything that needs exec review.

Suggested agenda (30–45 min):
- Quick introductions (5 min)
- Walk redlines in contract_redlines_v2.pdf (15–20 min)
- Confirm onboarding checklist items in onboarding-checklist.xlsx (10 min)
- Next steps / ownership / DocuSign timeline (5–10 min)

Proposed windows (PT):
- Today 3:00–3:45pm
- Tomorrow 9:00–9:45am or 1:00–1:45pm

If none of those work, please share two slots that fit your procurement/legal team and we'll confirm. Attaching the current redline PDF and the onboarding checklist for reference. Also attaching our SOC 2 summary in case your security team asks for it.

Thanks — would like to get this wrapped this week if possible.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: contract_redlines_v2.pdf (pdf), onboarding-checklist.xlsx (xlsx), soc2-type-ii-summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Kari O'Neil <kari.oneil@greenridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@greenridge.com>, Tyler Marr <tmarr@greenridge.com>
Date: 2027-03-07T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Contract sprint: finalize vendor onboarding checklist & redlines

Kimberly —

Thanks for sending these over. We like the sprint approach. Quick notes:
- Our legal lead (Tyler) is available today but only between 3:30–4:00pm PT (short). Procurement can do tomorrow 1:00–1:45pm PT.
- We need the SOC 2 summary up front (sending to our security team now) — the PDF you attached looks good at first glance.
- Two asks from procurement: a clarified data retention row in section 5, and the onboarding checklist to include a security contact field.

If you can do a short run today 3:30–4:00pm PT with Tyler + a follow-up tomorrow 1:00–1:45pm PT for procurement, that would work on our side. If you'd prefer a single longer session, we can do tomorrow 1:00–2:00pm PT.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Kari O'Neil
Director, Vendor Programs | Greenridge Systems
kari.oneil@greenridge.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-07T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Contract sprint: finalize vendor onboarding checklist & redlines

Kim / Laura —

If Greenridge can do the two short sessions, let's take both so we capture legal redlines first and then procurement acceptance. I can lead the redline walkthrough and ensure we capture every concession and escalation point. Laura — can you own the procurement checklist update (add the security contact field Kari requested) and keep procurement's action items in the doc?

Also: Tyler asked whether we have the full SOC 2 Type II report available for review under an NDA. We have the summary attached; I'll pull the report into the secure folder and share a link if needed.

I'll tentatively accept today 3:30–4:00pm PT on the calendar and schedule the procurement session tomorrow 1:00–1:45pm PT. Kimberly, want me to send the invites and include a short pre-read highlighting the two data-retention positions we'd like to propose?

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai

Attachment referenced: soc2-type-ii-summary.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Kari O'Neil <kari.oneil@greenridge.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@greenridge.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-07T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Contract sprint: finalize vendor onboarding checklist & redlines

Perfect — thank you, all.

I've booked two calendar events:
- Today 3:30–4:00pm PT: Legal redline sprint (Tyler + Kari + Kimberly + Sean) — calendar invite sent.
- Tomorrow 1:00–1:45pm PT: Procurement checklist & onboarding acceptance (Procurement Team + Laura + Kimberly + Sean) — invite sent.

I've attached a 1-page pre-read that calls out the two data-retention positions we plan to walk through and the proposed language for the security contact field in the checklist. If anyone needs a longer slot, let me know and we can extend the procurement session to 1:00–2:00pm PT tomorrow.

Looking forward to wrapping this up.

Regards,
Kimberly

Attachments: pre-read-data-retention-1p.pdf
